thread:
Renee: Quick drop 1-line goal + feedback 'sparkline' template. Designed to show progress + signal for calibration in one line. Pasteable.

Jon: Curious  what's a sparkline in this context?

Renee: Tiny: a short progress band (start->now->target). Example: 'Progress: 20%->60%->90% (on track)'. Keeps timeline visible in self-reviews.

Samir: Nice, can you show full one-line template for ICs?

Renee: Sure  copy-paste: 
`Goal: <one-line>. Outcome: <metric>. Progress: <start%->now%->target% (status)>. Evidence: <one short bullet or link>. Ask: <one-line> (opt)`

Doris: Add a one-sentence peer feedback paste?

Renee: Peer line: `Observed: <impact>. Example: <brief>. Quick tip: <one concrete next step>.`

Samir: Love the Progress band. Will include in our sprint review template.

peopleops-bot: Uploaded: /drive/people-ops/sparkline-goal-template-v1.txt :white_check_mark:

Jon: Can we make a manager variant that adds a calibration flag? e.g., Calib: high/med/low evidence.

Renee: Yup added as optional suffix: `Calib: <high|med|low>` — keeps packets scannable. If folks want CSV export for bulk import to review forms, tell me and I'll export.
